config.open-menu-key.name: Call NPC key
config.open-menu-key.tooltip: Opens a text box for you to type the name of the NPC you want to teleport to you.
config.release-npc-key.name: Release NPC key
config.release-npc-key.tooltip: Aim your cursor at the called NPC and press this key to send them back to their normal routine.
naming-menu.prompt: Which NPC do you want to call?
error.no-npc-under-cursor: Aim your cursor at a called NPC to release them.
message.npc-arrived: {{name}} came to you! Aim at them and press the release key when you're done.
message.npc-auto-released: {{name}} was automatically released because you left the area.
